body:
Saving the item edit dialog re-stamps EVERY field with a fresh LWW clock, not
just the fields the user changed — which silently reverts collaborators'
concurrent edits to the untouched fields and defeats the whole point of
field-level LWW (spec §6: "edits to different fields of the same item merge").

Scenario: Alice opens the edit dialog for "Milk" (form snapshots name="Milk").
Bob renames it to "Oat milk" and syncs. Alice only edits the note and saves →
her save pushes name="Milk" with a fresh timestamp, which beats Bob's rename.
Bob's edit is silently lost.

Both clients have it:
- web: ListPage.handleSave / RegistryPage.handleSave build fieldPatch(...) for
  all 7 fields with nowMs() regardless of what changed (ItemDialog returns the
  full value set with no dirty tracking).
- android: ItemFormViewModel.performSave() unconditionally calls rename /
  setStatus / setCategory / setStores / setQuantity / setPrice / setNote, and
  each ItemsRepo setter stamps a fresh clock.

Fix: diff the form values against the snapshot loaded when the dialog opened
and only push/stamp fields whose value actually changed. (ListPropsPage and
ListsRepo already do this correctly for list fields — single-field pushes.)
Note the add-mode "picked an existing suggestion" path intentionally writes
all fields (the user is adopting the prefill) — keep the diff against the
PICKED item's values there, so an unmodified adopt only flips status.

Files: web/src/pages/ListPage.tsx, web/src/pages/RegistryPage.tsx,
web/src/components/ItemDialog.tsx,
android .../ui/item/ItemFormViewModel.kt (+ tests in both clients).
title: Item edit dialog stamps ALL fields with fresh clocks — reverts collaborators concurrent edits (web + Android)
